newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - July 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - July 18.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- Kim Sun-hong, Chairman of Kia Group said in an interview with Chosun Ilbo on Thursday that he is sure Kia Group will recover and added the group is selling real estate worth 1.8 trillion.
Park Chan-jong, a ruling New Korea Party presidential hopeful, could submit evidence to state prosecutors that the party's strongest contender Lee Hoi-chang paid party delegtes to buy their votes.

Public polls on Thursday conducted by the newspaper and Media Research show that Lee Hoi-chang, former premier, has the largest support of the seven ruling New Korea Party candidates running for the party nomination.

- The Defense Ministry on Thursday placed South Korean army units along frontline areas on a higher state of vigilance to guard against further North Korean provacations following Wednesday's firefight in the Demilitarized Zone.
